interface.shortDescription: 全引擎全平台游戏专家团 + 正式资源流水线 + 软著申报能力线
interface.longDescription: Game production skills for the full lifecycle: concept, preproduction and vertical slice, iterative playable sprint builds, production, Alpha/Beta/Gold QA gates, multiplatform release and live operations. Includes Cocos, Unity, Godot and Unreal Engine 5 guidance plus AI image, animated GIF, sprite-sheet, sound and music workflows. Gate templates capture evidence and review decisions; docs-only checks do not claim a build or QA pass. A China software copyright filing line adds name pre-check, 60-page source-code documents, a software manual, a 12-item risk audit and a single-file beginner guide report.
